english.title: Sex offences - abuse position of trust - engage in sexual activity
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being a person aged eighteen or over, engaged in sexual activity other than sexual intercourse with, or directed towards **(..SPECIFY PERSON..), a person under that age and at the time you were in a position of trust in relation to that person
english.legislation: Contrary to section 3(1) and (4) of the Sexual Offences (Amendment) Act 2000.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
being a person aged eighteen years or over
in a position of trust
engage in sexual activity other than sexual intercourse
with person under 18

investigatoraction.description: Attracts liability for entry on sex offenders register
Consider an application for a sexual harm prevention order after conviction
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
THIS OFFENCE IS NOW OBSOLETE

(i) See Section 3(2) and (3) for defences. Note in particular Section 3(3) which stipulates the circumstances in which a prior relationship will obviate the commission of this offence.
(ii) See Section 3(5) for meaning of 'sexual activity' for the purposes of this offence and Section 6 for its meaning generally for the purpose of certain enactments.
(iii) See Section 4 for the meaning of 'position of trust'. This section sets out 4 conditions, any of which must be satisfied, to show a 'position of trust' for the purposes of this offence.
(iv) See offence wording H4422 for the offence of a person aged 18 or over in a position of trust having sexual intercourse (whether vaginal or anal) with a person under 18.
(v) This offence is included in Schedule 1(1) to the Sex Offenders Act 1997, therefore a person convicted or cautioned for this offence must (subject to the exceptions and provisions contained in Schedule 1(2) and (3)) comply with the requirements of section 2 of that Act.
(vi) Repealed by s.140 of and Schedule 7 to the Sexual Offences Act 2003

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Five years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
